rationale: A new header-only primitive in the exported runtime directory: wakes a sleeping consumer from a realtime producer with no lock and no system call while the consumer is busy. It has no Pulp-only dependency, so the next re-export carries it and Vellum can use it for the same audio-thread-to-worker handoffs. core/runtime/CMakeLists.txt only lists the header in the runtime unit headers, which the export carries with it.
